caveats.en: The PC version requires EA Javelin anti-cheat, which has no Arm64 driver yet; Battlefield 6, which uses the same anti-cheat, refuses to launch on RTX Spark. EA says Javelin reaches RTX Spark in early 2027.
caveats.zh-TW: PC 版需要 EA Javelin 反作弊，而它還沒有 Arm64 驅動程式；同樣使用 Javelin 的《戰地風雲 6》在 RTX Spark 上無法啟動。EA 表示 Javelin 會在 2027 年初支援 RTX Spark。
